opening.argument: The video directs viewers to fund a trading account with Bitcoin, with access appearing only after an administrator confirms the transfer. It then presents the account as producing recurring daily trading results reported by email. Registration is not portrayed as an individual investment alone: viewers are told to consult a sponsor about selecting a left- or right-hand position, and are encouraged to refer friends through a registration link. These instructions establish a sponsor-directed, multi-level team structure in which participation involves payment, placement, and recruitment.

citations.quote: Once the admin has confirmed your Bitcoin transfer, it will appear in your trading account.
Each day you will receive a statement via email telling you the results of the trades.
Please check with your sponsor whether you should select the left or right-hand position.
Should you wish to refer your friends you can send them your registration link
